release_decision.reason: The hardware-conditioned adapter bundle is numerically stable, zero-impact at initialization, geometry-live, leaves all D001-MEMORY base tensors unchanged, has only a negligible held-out loss delta well inside the frozen catastrophic-regression tolerance, and completed the direct no-camera/no-microphone chat probe with zero flagged sensor-claim turns. It is therefore eligible as an experimental D001-QUANTUM configuration. D001-MEMORY remains the formal base checkpoint because this stage is a separate adapter-only configuration, and the matched-control result is null for hardware-specific advantage.

next_action: Proceed to D001-TWIN only with provenance-verified user-specific measurement packets; public demo/default/Ghost Mode signals remain ineligible as real twin measurements. D001-HANDS remains after the descendant-model stages inside the approved disposable research range.
